'''Moonstruck Pass''' was the mountain pass outside of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Galu]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]] where [[Elan Tallah|Elan]] and the [[Hill people]] drove off the [[Beju-Tallah dynasty]] forces led by [[Lonnag Giba]].
